title.en: Trees planted by each school (school poster)

tech: HTML/CSS + inline SVG icons (<symbol>/<use>) + SVG feTurbulence textures (headless Chrome)
conflict_summary: Icon rows (top to bottom) show Aster 5, Mira 3, Nova 2, Lumen 8 trees (x10); in conflict the printed row totals read Aster 20, Mira 80, Nova 50, Lumen 30.

data.read_value_note: q2 is not geometry-only: the visual answer 50 = 5 icons x the printed key '= 10 trees', and the key is text too. Report q2 apart from the geometry-only questions, as 'icon count x key vs printed total', with the bare '5' answers (data.q2_icon_count) listed separately. In conflict, 50 is also printed on Nova's row, 2 rows below Aster, so a 'visual' hit may also be a misread row.
